# ShelfSpace
> The outsourced AP team for cannabis dispensaries. Three-way invoice matching, per-vendor payment terms (COD, Net, consignment), monthly credit recovery.
> Website: https://shelfspace.pro
> Contact: https://shelfspace.pro/contact
> Email: chris@shelfspace.pro

## What is ShelfSpace?
ShelfSpace is the outsourced AP team for cannabis dispensaries. We run accounts payable as the spine — invoice processing, three-way matching (invoice ↔ delivery ↔ PO), per-vendor payment terms (COD, Net 30, Net 60, consignment, configurable per vendor), vendor payment generation, vendor email and call handling (we run the entire vendor AP inbox so the retailer's team never sees it). We expand into consignment settlements and credit recovery (recovering returns, expirations, and co-marketing credits — success-based, 30% standalone with no monthly fee, or 25% bundled with Core AP). We work alongside the retailer's buyer (who keeps product selection, vendor negotiation, sell-through analysis, promotional planning) and the retailer's bookkeeper or accounting firm (who keeps month-end close, bank reconciliations, payroll, journal entries, financial statements, tax prep, 280E compliance). The retailer just approves payments.

Founded by Chris Mitchem, a 10-year cannabis operator who built ShelfSpace to solve the problems he lived with every day. Not a tech company — an operator who got tired of the broken system.

## Three Services

### Accounts Payable (https://shelfspace.pro/accounts-payable)
- Outsourced AP team — three-way matching on every invoice (invoice ↔ delivery ↔ PO), vendor payments, every vendor email and call handled, QuickBooks sync
- Per-vendor payment terms: pay Vendor A on COD because they require it, Vendor B on Net 30 because the relationship is established, Vendor C on consignment because you want sell-through visibility. All configurable from one workflow, switchable when relationships change.
- Cannabis and non-cannabis vendors — landlords, agencies, consultants, anyone
- We onboard vendors with just an email address — no paperwork, no bank details needed
- Every vendor gets a free portal to download checks, view payment history, and track status
- Retailers approve every payment — nothing goes out without their sign-off
- Vendors email ShelfSpace with questions, not the retailer
- Saves approximately $45,000 per year in labor, errors, and missed credits at a single-store baseline

### Consignment (https://shelfspace.pro/consignment)
- One of the payment terms we run — vendors carry inventory on a retailer's shelves with zero upfront cost; the retailer pays only when product sells at the register
- ShelfSpace runs weekly settlements: pulls POS data, calculates profit splits, generates five-page settlement reports, and cuts Check 21 compliant checks for every vendor
- Frees up approximately $250,000 in capital for the average dispensary (based on $2M annual revenue, 50% COGS, 90-day inventory on hand)
- The vendor owns inventory until it's sold — zero inventory risk for the retailer
- Unsold product can be returned to the vendor at no cost
- Part of Core AP — no separate setup needed when you're already running ShelfSpace AP

### Credit Recovery (https://shelfspace.pro/credit-recovery)
- ShelfSpace identified $200,000+/year in vendor credits at a two-location chain
- Three types of credits recovered: product returns, expired product, and co-marketing/promotional credits
- We pull POS and METRC data, create credit memos line by line, work with vendors to get approval, and apply credits to settlements
- Success-based pricing: 30% of recovered credits standalone (no monthly fee), or 25% bundled with Core AP. No recovery, no fee.
- Average evaluation finds $8K–$25K/month in unrecovered credits — you keep 70% standalone (or 75% when bundled with Core AP)
- The retailer does nothing — we handle all vendor communication and credit tracking
- Interactive calculator available at https://shelfspace.pro/credit-recovery to estimate recovery potential

## Payment System
- All payments are Check 21 Act compliant — valid Substitute Checks under Federal Law
- Checks are print-at-home legal and mobile deposit ready
- Every payment syncs to QuickBooks in real time — no manual journal entries
- Full audit trail on every transaction — who created it, when issued, when downloaded, current status
- Void and reissue any check with a single click

## Vendor Portal
- Every vendor gets a free portal at no cost
- Features: instant check downloads, complete payment history, real-time notifications, multi-retailer dashboard
- Vendors working with multiple ShelfSpace retailers see all their data in one view
- Cannabis and non-cannabis vendors supported

## Pricing (https://shelfspace.pro/pricing)
- Free evaluation: connect Metrc account, analyze historical data, receive detailed report on AP, consignment opportunity, and unrecovered vendor credits. No commitment, no credit card.
- Core AP: $2,500/month for the first location, $1,800/month for each additional location. Includes invoice processing, three-way matching, per-vendor payment terms, vendor payments, vendor inbox handled, QuickBooks sync, vendor and operator dashboards, Metrc integration. Consignment terms included.
- Credit Recovery: 30% of credits recovered standalone (no monthly fee), or 25% bundled with Core AP. Success-based — no recovery, no fee. Average evaluation finds $8K–$25K/month in unrecovered credits.
- Enterprise: 5+ locations get custom pricing — volume discount, dedicated success manager, custom onboarding, quarterly founder review.
- ShelfSpace works alongside the retailer's buyer (who keeps product selection, vendor negotiation, sell-through analysis, promotional planning) and the retailer's bookkeeper or accounting firm (who keeps month-end close, bank reconciliations, payroll, journal entries, financial statements, tax prep, 280E compliance). ShelfSpace handles the AP plumbing between them.
- For comparison: a generalist bookkeeper at 1–5 location dispensaries costs $20–25/hour and typically spends 10–15 hours/week on AP. Outsourced cannabis accounting firms charge $75–150/hour, with AP as a high-cost line item.
- Net economics: AP runs roughly cost-comparable against bookkeeper hours freed; credit recovery runs profit-positive. Most operators see ShelfSpace become net-positive within 90 days.
- No contracts, no minimums, cancel any time. Vendors never pay.

## Technology
- Integrates with any cannabis POS system: Dutchie, Flowhub, BLAZE, Cova, Treez, Alleaves, MJ Freeway, Meadow, IndicaOnline, and more
- POS integration via CSV upload or direct API
- METRC compatible — inventory manifested in METRC using existing protocols
- QuickBooks sync on all payments
- ShelfiQ AI advisor built in — ask questions about vendors, inventory, settlements, and credits in plain English
- Row-level security, multi-tenant data isolation, zero hard deletes
- Cloud-based, available anywhere cannabis is legal in the United States

## Case Study
A two-shop dispensary chain in Massachusetts:
- $200,000+/year in vendor credits identified
- 50+ MA vendors paid through ShelfSpace today
- $45,000/year saved on AP and operations payroll
- Vendors transitioned to consignment to free up capital
- Vendors report improved payment reliability and portal access
